info.description: Ledgers is not tax or legal advice. Check rates and returns before you file.

schema.title: AccountsNumberInput
schema.description:
The input of `accounts.archive`, `accounts.restore` and `accounts.get`:
the account number (from the path).

schema.title: AccountsChangedOutput
schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: AccountsCreateInput
schema.description: The input of `accounts.create`. `type` is the account class.

number.description: The account number: 2 to 10 ASCII digits, unique in the chart.

name.description: The name shown for the account (a custom name).

type.description: The account class: asset, liability, equity, income or expense.

parent.description: The parent account number; absent means the root of the chart.

currency.description: The account's currency code; absent means the company base currency.

schema.title: AccountsChangedOutput
schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: AccountsGetOutput
schema.description: The output of `accounts.get`: the account and its recent activity.

activity.description: The most recent entries touching the account, newest first.

schema.title: AccountsNumberInput
schema.description:
The input of `accounts.archive`, `accounts.restore` and `accounts.get`:
the account number (from the path).

schema.title: AccountsChangedOutput
schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: AccountsUpdateInput
schema.description:
The input of `accounts.update`. `number` comes from the path. Only the
fields present change; `clear_parent` moves the account to the root.

type.description: A new class; refused once the account has postings or children.

tags.description: A new tag list, replacing the old one.

clear_parent.description: Move the account to the root of the chart.

schema.title: AccountsChangedOutput
schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: ConfirmInput
schema.description: Input of `bills.confirm`: a person confirms the vendor and the IBAN of a bill.

schema.title: BillInput
schema.description:
The input of `bills.create`, and of `bills.update` (where the bill id comes
from the path and the document stays as it was). The id and the document
are filled by the server on create.

id.description: The new bill's id (server-generated on create).

document_id.description: The document the bill is for (create only).

vendor_iban.description: The IBAN printed on the invoice.

confidence.description: Confidence per extracted field, 0 to 100 (empty for manual bills).

reader.description:
Which reader produced the fields: `rules`, `anthropic`, `minimax`, or
`unread-scan` for a scanned PDF no configured reader takes. Filled by
the server from the extraction.

created_by.description: The caller, recorded on the bill (filled by the server).

schema.title: ExtractInput
schema.description:
`bills.extract`'s gate and reader: the caller needs the draft tier, and
the document must be stored.

journal_id.description: The journal to post into; defaults to the general journal `GN`.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year; defaults to the year of the posting date.

schema.title: UpdateInput
schema.description: Input of `bills.update`: the bill id and the corrected fields.

id.description: The new bill's id (server-generated on create).

document_id.description: The document the bill is for (create only).

vendor_iban.description: The IBAN printed on the invoice.

confidence.description: Confidence per extracted field, 0 to 100 (empty for manual bills).

reader.description:
Which reader produced the fields: `rules`, `anthropic`, `minimax`, or
`unread-scan` for a scanned PDF no configured reader takes. Filled by
the server from the extraction.

created_by.description: The caller, recorded on the bill (filled by the server).

schema.title: DocumentUrlOutput
schema.description: The output of `documents.download_url`: a relative link and its expiry.

url.description: The link, relative to the API origin.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working (Unix seconds).

schema.title: EntryRecordView
schema.description: One posted entry, as the app's `EntryRecord` types it.

external_id.description: The source application's idempotency key, if it gave one.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year its number is scoped to.

number.description: The gapless number within the journal and fiscal year.

posted_by.description: Who posted it: `agent` (an agent key) or `person`.

reverses.description: The entry this one reverses, when it is a reversal.

reversed_by.description: The entry that reverses this one, if any.

schema.title: EntriesPostInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.post`: a balanced entry and, optionally, the
journal and fiscal year to post it to (defaults: journal `GN`, and the
fiscal year of the posting date).

journal_id.description: The journal to post into; defaults to the general journal `GN`.

fiscal_year.description:
The fiscal year the entry number is scoped to; defaults to the
posting date's year.

entry.description: The entry: header, dates and lines.
The posted entry with its assigned number.

schema.title: EntriesReverseInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.reverse`: the external id of the entry to reverse
(from the path) and the posting date of the reversal (default: today).

external_id.description: The `external_id` the reversed entry was posted with.

posting_date.description: The reversal's posting date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; defaults to today (UTC).

entry.description: The posted entry with its assigned number.

name.description: A label for the key, shown in the app and the audit trail.

limits.description:
Per-currency limits, keyed by ISO 4217 code. A currency with no entry
is not allowed at all (fail closed).

schema.title: KeysCreateOutput
schema.description: Output of `keys.create`: the key, and its full token, shown once.

token.description: The full bearer token. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.

keys.description: Every agent key of the company, revoked ones included.

schema.title: KeysRevokeInput
schema.description: Input of `keys.revoke`: the key's `id`, as `keys.list` returns it.

equity_accounts.description: The equity accounts alone (capital, reserves, retained earnings).

current_year_result.description:
Income minus expenses from the fiscal year start up to `as_of`
(Jahresüberschuss, or Jahresfehlbetrag when negative).

difference.description: Assets minus liabilities minus equity. Zero when `balanced`.

balanced.description: Whether the sheet balances on its own: assets = liabilities + equity.

months.description: One row per month, in order.

top_expense_accounts.description: The largest expense accounts in the range.

dimension.description: The dimension kind the split is by, when one was asked for.

by_dimension.description: Revenue and expenses per dimension value; empty without a dimension.

activity.description: Entries posted per month by actor; months with none are left out.

AccountView.description: One account of the chart, as the app's `Account` types it, plus its balances.

display_name.description:
The custom name a person gave the account, or `null` to show the
translated `name_key`.

account_type.description: The account class: asset, liability, equity, income, expense.

currency.description: The account currency, or `null` for the company base currency.

parent.description: The parent account number, if any.

tags.description: The chart tags of the account.

is_postable.description: Whether the account accepts postings (a leaf of the chart).

archived.description: Whether the account is archived: kept for history, no new postings.

balances.description: The balance per base currency, debit-positive (empty when no postings).

minor.description: The minor units as a string.

AccountActivityView.description: One recent entry of an account, as the account page lists it.

entry_id.description: The entry's id: the journal entry to open.

journal_id.description: The journal the entry posted into.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year the entry number is scoped to.

minor.description: The account's signed base amount in the entry (debit positive).

currency.description: The base currency code of the amount.

BillView.description: A bill as commands and the app see it.

document_id.description: The document the bill is for.

confidence.description: Confidence per extracted field, 0 to 100 (empty for manual bills).

reader.description: Which reader produced the fields, when one did (see `BillInput::reader`).

posted_entry_id.description: The posted journal entry, once posted.

journal_preview.description: The entry the bill posts as, when every amount and account is known.

Status.description: The status of a bill, derived on every read.

oneOf.description: A check failed or a flag is open.
Every check passed and nothing is open: it can be posted.
A person discarded the draft; it can no longer post.

VendorView.description: The vendor, as the bill shows it.

needs_review.description: True until a person confirms the vendor.

BillLine.description: One bill line as entered or extracted, with its expense account.

vat_rate_bp.description: The VAT rate in basis points.

expense_account.description: The expense account the line debits (a chart account number).

suggested_from.description: The bill whose line this account was suggested from, when it was.

CheckView.description: A check as the API shows it.

PreviewLine.description: One line of the journal preview: account, side and amount in minor units.

minor.description: The amount, minor units of the bill currency.

Document.description:
A stored document, as commands and the app see it. The PDF text layer is
not part of the view: it is read by the policy screen, not returned.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file bytes, lowercase hex.

original_name.description: The file name as uploaded (display only; never trusted for type).

created_at.description: When the document was first stored (ISO 8601, UTC).

has_text_layer.description: Whether the PDF text layer was read (false for images and scans).

RetentionClass.description: How long the original must be kept.

oneOf.description: Ten years (the default; the German `GoBD` period for books and vouchers).
Kept until someone removes it by hand.

ExtractReport.description: Output of `bills.extract`: the bill and how its fields were read.

warnings.description: What the person should know about the reading.

needs_photo.description:
True when the file is a scanned PDF that no configured reader takes:
it needs a photo upload or the fields typed in by hand.

PostedEntryView.description: The journal entry a bill became.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year the number is scoped to.

EntryLineRecordView.description: One entry line, as the app's `EntryLineRecord` types it.

base.description: The base amount, in minor units of the entry's base currency.

EntryRecordView.description: One posted entry, as the app's `EntryRecord` types it.

external_id.description: The source application's idempotency key, if it gave one.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year its number is scoped to.

number.description: The gapless number within the journal and fiscal year.

posted_by.description: Who posted it: `agent` (an agent key) or `person`.

reverses.description: The entry this one reverses, when it is a reversal.

reversed_by.description: The entry that reverses this one, if any.

external_id.description: External ID from the source application (for idempotency).

source_app.description: The application that posted this entry.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year the number is scoped to.

LimitAmounts.description:
One currency's limits, as canonical decimal strings in major units
(`"1000.00"` for EUR is 100000 minor units).

per_entry.description: The most one entry may move in this currency.

per_day.description: The most the key may move in this currency in a rolling day.

AgentKeyView.description: One agent key as the owner sees it. Never carries the secret.

name.description: The label the key was created with.

prefix.description: The public prefix, `lk_live_<id>`. The secret part is never shown again.

limits.description: Per-currency limits, in canonical major-unit strings.

created_by.description: The person who created the key.

last_used_at.description: When the key last authenticated a request, at most one write per minute.

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked, if it was.

cash.description: Cash and bank balance at month end.

payables.description: Payables balance at month end, as a positive amount owed.

amount.description: The account's expenses in the range.

share_bps.description: Share of the range's expenses in basis points (1/100 of a percent).

DimensionShareView.description: Revenue and expenses of one dimension value in `reports.trends`.

ActivityMonthView.description: One month of entries posted, by actor, in `reports.trends`.

agent.description: Entries posted by an agent key.

debit.description: The debit total of the period.

credit.description: The credit total of the period.
